price_basis: Yahoo adjusted market prices, not issuer NAV
available_dates_mean: observations in the requested download window
boundary_policy: both requested dates must have observed prices
daily_return_interval: identical starting and ending price dates across all included ETFs
daily_returns_usage: shared sample for volatility/covariance/correlation only; gaps mean it must not be compounded into full-period growth or used as a complete backtest
growth_convention: full observed return history per ETF, including returns spanning a missing observation; no prices are filled or invented
drawdown_convention: adjusted-price wealth path; gaps may hide larger drawdowns
distribution_treatment: Yahoo adjustments already reflected in adjusted_close; dividends and capital gains are not added again; excludes client taxes and costs
volatility_convention: sample standard deviation on shared matched intervals multiplied by sqrt(252); adding ETFs can change this shared sample
status_ok_means: calculation checks passed, not investment suitability or provider validation; calendar gaps remain flagged
correlation_method: Pearson correlation of matched daily total returns
